author: D

components.title: Calculate eligible customer revenues
components.what: Remove exact duplicate order rows so each order counts once; retain only shipped and pending orders; calculate each order's revenue as units × unit_price; aggregate revenue by customer and calculate total revenue.

components.title: Compute highest customer revenue share
components.what: Identify the customer with the largest aggregated revenue and divide it by total revenue, multiplying by 100 and rounding to one decimal place.
